title: SUPERB SCOOTER/BIKE RENTAL
text: It is a great scooter/motorcycle rental the patterns are very cool and offer scooters at rather low prices! I strongly advise you if you go through Barcelona to visit the city, by scooter it is much more interesting.

title: Best part of the weekend
text: Fantastic experience. We were 5 guys looking for some motos to tour Barcelona. It was quick and easy yet informative and professional. Will definitely be back there in the future.
author: A3476IBdanp

title: Great scooters and service
text:
Me and my girlfriend rented an 125cc scooter for a day to take us up the mountains surrounding Barcelona.  This place was great as not only did it have a range of different cc's, but also a range of scooters at each (to get access to this range I imagine you should book in advance).  Me and my girlfriend speak Spanish but the staff spoke English and the customer service was very efficient.

author: jacobmG1965XE

title: Really great!!!
text: We rented 2x125cc scooters for 24 hours. Our experience was really great - the scooters were of a great quality. We travelled to Montserat - the service guy provided us with all the relevant information about the insurance, location we are about to go and cautioned us about the possible warnings. And spoke English which is great!! Thanks a lot for everything.
author: laura_T7193FR

title: Perfect Experience
text: These guys are amazing. Rented for a day, within 5 minutes everything was ready to go. They speak good english, explain all you need to know and the helmets are very clean from the inside. Top service, definitely coming back here. 👍

title: Wow!
text: I would recomend this place to everyone; really nice bikes, the staff is always helpful and friendly and they got the best deals and prices in Barcelona. Great place!

title: Great scooters and service
text: All motorbikes are in very good conditions and price you have several and very good price options. The opening hours are very flexible and the service is great. I very much recommend it and have rented motorbikes several times here.
